leadText: Pietra's grandmother is a minor character who appeared in The Grand Rhydon Plan.
plainText:
Pietra's grandmother is a minor character who appeared in The Grand Rhydon Plan.

==In the manga==
She was first seen in the cave when Pietra took and there. Later, after Pietra caught a for her tunnel project, she took her grandmother to a nearby town and celebrated with Ash and his friends after the project was complete.

==In animation==
Pietra's grandmother was only mentioned in Right On, Rhydon! when Pietra mentioned that she needed to complete a tunnel for her grandma to have access to a nearby town.
